question: At which intervening boundary do the causally confirmed L9H1/L9H4 writes acquire the orientation of the sparse occupied M11 reader mode?
evidence_status: Prospective layerwise localization after L11H3 established the RMS-Jacobian transport program. No v23 patched-vs-native boundary state for L9H1/H4 has been opened.

frozen_design.measurement: Capture native base/donor and each singleton patch. At each residual boundary, add its patched-minus-base delta to the base block11 pre-normalization raw state, apply the now-validated exact RMS transport and literal M11 bilinear map, then project into the frozen reader basis. Compare with the actual singleton M11 response on target, P, C, and reporter halves.
frozen_design.interpretation: The first boundary whose identity-carried delta predicts the actual occupied-mode response localizes where intervening transformations become dispensable. This is an operational transport boundary, not proof that earlier blocks are literally identity.

predictions.pred_a_authority_hooks_boundaries_closur: All hashes, boundary hook counts, raw/normalized reconstructions, self no-op, finiteness, and five-forward price pass.
predictions.pred_b_both_L9_heads_localize_before_M11: Each head has at least one pre-normalization boundary with target cosine >=.90 and residual <=.25.
predictions.pred_c_block11_input_is_a_sufficient_tra: For both heads, identity-carrying the block11-input delta to the base post-attention raw state, then applying exact RMS/M11, predicts target response at the same bars.
predictions.pred_d_localized_boundary_is_split_stabl: The selected earliest passing boundary has >=.90 cosine in both reporter halves and P/C response RMS below target response RMS for both heads.

opposing_interpretations.block9_transport: The block10-input boundary passes: block9 constructs the transferable write and blocks10/11 mainly carry it.
opposing_interpretations.block10_transport: Only block11 input passes: block10 is an essential converter/grouping boundary.
opposing_interpretations.block11_transport: Only post-attention raw or normalized M11 input passes: block11 attention/normalization performs essential conversion.
opposing_interpretations.distributed_nonlinear_transport: No pre-normalization boundary passes: retain the realized causal response as the interface and decompose paired transformations rather than forcing a single linear edge.

decision: The earliest valid boundary becomes the input interface for a compact L9-to-M11 transport program and the target of selective removal/rescue.
